messages.subject: Project Falcon - availability definition & augmentation
messages.plaintextBody:
James - on the 97.75% availability number, I want to be sure the definition excludes the planned augmentation outages. Schedule 3 should treat the augmentation window (we expect one major augmentation around year 5) as a Permitted Outage. Can you confirm that's how it reads?

Marcus

messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus - yes. Permitted Outages cover planned maintenance up to 120 hours per Contract Year plus Force Majeure, and we'll add an express carve-out for the scheduled augmentation works so they don't count against availability. I'll make sure the execution version reflects it.

James
